eventDetail.scope: The conference will cover key areas of electrical and electronics engineering, including power systems, renewable energy technologies, smart grids, power electronics, control systems, instrumentation, VLSI design, embedded systems, and communication engineering. It will also include cutting-edge domains such as artificial intelligence, data science, IoT, cybersecurity, and smart computing. The conference emphasizes inclusive innovation, women’s leadership, interdisciplinary collaboration, and technology-driven solutions for societal and industrial challenges.
